tools.name: get_latest
tools.description: Returns today's checked items from the Context Pill feed (releases, tools, techniques). Each item has a verification status, a source trust score, evidence links, why it matters and an optional try-this step. The optional topic parameter filters by a word such as 'claude', 'codex' or 'open weights'.

tools.name: search_claims
tools.description: Searches every claim Context Pill has published (the ledger). The query takes 1 to 3 key words, such as a product or model name: every word must appear somewhere in a claim, so long queries often miss ('claude spreadsheet' works, a full sentence usually returns 0). Returns status at publication, how

tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: Lists the sources Context Pill reads, with tier, trust score (posterior mean), its conservative lower bound (LB10) and the number of resolved tips. Every source starts at a neutral Beta(2,2) prior (trust 0.50) and moves when its claims are re-checked. The optional name parameter filters by source na
